text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――The "Deciding the Strongest Arc."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "The foundation to make it a reality is finally falling into place!!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Vivlos-san, regarding the Takarazuka Kinen
you mentioned earlier—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm running! 
It's my first Grand Prix, but...
...I've watched my big sisters race, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"‘Super-strong Umamusume confirmed to run!’
‘Gotta go in person!’ ‘Vib-chi, back at Hanshin after so long!’
‘[Breaking] Worried whether I can snag Shinkansen seats.’"

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Man in Black
text_block_list.text:
All backup systems on this island
are now fully operational.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks!
Now, let's begin our training."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —The one who stands at the summit will be me.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And yesterday, someone at the station
was talking about the Takarazuka Kinen, too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: The girls who did great at the Tenno Sho (Spring) and even international champions are coming to Takarazuka! Did you know that, Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
This is what the "Ultimate Decisive Battle Arc" is all about!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With so many top contenders gathered, the papers are buzzing
with anticipation that something big is coming! And then—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding♪)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It's here!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Blast-chan!
I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah, have a safe trip!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, this is so fascinating...!
So this is the Grand Prix...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
The results for 'that thing' are finally in!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The final results of the Takarazuka Kinen fan vote are in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the Grand Prix GⅠ "Takarazuka Kinen,"
there is a fan voting campaign
to select the Umamusume they wish to see run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, it will become clear which Umamusume holds the hearts of the people right now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And 1st place in the fan poll is—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—This is Kita-chan's childhood friend,
Satono Diamond-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………
I didn't think we could leave her out either.
choice_data_list: Because she's the horse girl who carries on Kitasan's will?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are people who say that, yes.
That it's because we're childhood friends.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, it's not just about her traits!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan is unmistakably
the strongest contender needed for the "Battle for the Strongest" arc!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Defeating Kita-chan in the Arima Kinen two years ago, and running on the world's grandest stage in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe last year!
Truly a hero carrying the hopes of Japan!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you remember that talk we had before about my "background"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One's background. It is what pushes an Umamusume's back,
the "reason" that drives them forward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan has become an umamusume
who carries an even greater legacy on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Her vow to become a legendary Umamusume for the Satono family, the experience of representing Japan, and parting with her best friend.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is no Umamusume heading into the Takarazuka Kinen
with a deeper, richer backstory than her.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, we've got something carrying on our own backs
that doesn't lose out to whatever legacy they have!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You must know by now, Trainer!
My backstory has grown even more!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She stunned the fans at the rainy Kikuka Sho! And for this Takarazuka Kinen, an intriguing rivalry has taken shape!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I've come this far step by steady step,
I can carry the weight of these '40,000 votes'!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—40,000 votes.
That was the number of votes Kiseki gathered in the Takarazuka Kinen fan balloting.
choice_data_list: (It's all the expectations Kiseki has to carry.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right now, I can run side by side with Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the main character, I can surpass the strongest
and create the greatest, most exciting masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A message from Kiseki arrives on my device.
I tap the displayed download link.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My pen just kept flowing on its own.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared strategies other than 'Late Closer' this time.
Let's figure out what works best!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Phew—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting go of a running style that's already perfected
would send shivers down the spine of an ordinary horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, Kiseki can do it.
—To take on the challenge, in search of "excitement."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Going for one more rep!
—Haaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —...Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Almond Eye-san.
Having won the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks),
all that remains is the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Her next aim must surely be
the glory of the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...You're right,
first I think I'll aim for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And beyond that lies—
